result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 16, 'col': 26}])
print(f"Result: {last_action_result}")

# Find remaining green tiles
seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
green_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"\nGreen tiles remaining: {len(green_nodes)}")
for n in green_nodes:
    min_r = min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])
    min_c = min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
    max_r = max(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])
    max_c = max(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
    center_r = (min_r + max_r) // 2
    center_c = (min_c + max_c) // 2
    print(f"  Green at ({min_r},{min_c})-({max_r},{max_c}), center=({center_r},{center_c})")

# Now automate remaining pairs
while True:
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    nodes = seg['nodes']
    green_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'N']
    if not green_nodes:
        print("\nNo more green tiles!")
        break
    
    # Click first green
    g = green_nodes[0]
    c_r = (min(p[0] for p in g['boundary']) + max(p[0] for p in g['boundary'])) // 2
    c_c = (min(p[1] for p in g['boundary']) + max(p[1] for p in g['boundary'])) // 2
    print(f"\nClicking green at ({c_r}, {c_c})")
    action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': c_r, 'col': c_c}])
    
    # Find g-bordered tile
    seg2 = current_frame.segmentation
    nodes2 = seg2['nodes']
    g_nodes = [n for n in nodes2 if n['color'] == 'g']
    if not g_nodes:
        print("No g border found, breaking")
        break
    
    all_g = []
    for n in g_nodes:
        for p in n['boundary']:
            all_g.append(p)
    t_r = (min(p[0] for p in all_g) + max(p[0] for p in all_g)) // 2
    t_c = (min(p[1] for p in all_g) + max(p[1] for p in all_g)) // 2
    print(f"Clicking g-bordered tile at ({t_r}, {t_c})")
    action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': t_r, 'col': t_c}])
    
    # Check for level completion
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done'):
        print("Level completed or done!")
        break
    
    # Check remaining
    seg3 = current_frame.segmentation
    nodes3 = seg3['nodes']
    gc = len([n for n in nodes3 if n['color'] == 'N'])
    print(f"Green remaining: {gc}")
    if gc >= len(green_nodes):
        print("No progress, breaking to avoid infinite loop")
        break
